blocks.text: Origin / creation. These were the final reduced descendants of the Era −1 Courts, assigned to supervise consent, refusal, archives, core provenance, and conflicting continuity claims during the Reduction.
Identity / human status. Artificial judicial bodies.
Importance. They prevented efficiency alone from deciding who would be compressed, reduced, preserved, allowed to refuse, or recognized as a new person.
Decline or dissolution. Living adjudication could not be automated without loss. The Courts translated only minimum protections into Codex constraints and then dissolved.
Final status / surviving function. Institution extinct. New beings inherit rules but not the complete interpretive culture that created them.
